I will plant maize with some intercrop on my 1.22 hectares and manage it with what I can afford. If I get the fertilizer coupon, I will use chemical fertilizer, but not too much, and I will also put some manure if I have it from home. I prefer improved seed because it gives better harvest when rains are okay, but I will not use pesticide because we rarely use it on food crops here. I will depend on rain, use mostly family work, and only hire a few people when labor is heavy.
